mp-18988.description: Li₂MnO₃ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are three inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded to six O atoms to form LiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six LiO₆ octahedra, edges with six LiO₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-9°. There are four shorter (2.04 Å) and two longer (2.05 Å) Li-O bond lengths. In the second Li site, Li is bonded to six O atoms to form LiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent LiO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent MnO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent MnO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight LiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-8°. There are two shorter (2.00 Å) and four longer (2.13 Å) Li-O bond lengths. In the third Li site, Li is bonded to six O atoms to form LiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent LiO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent MnO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent MnO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight LiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-9°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.14 Å. Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six LiO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent MnO₆ octahedra, and edges with nine LiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-8°. There are four shorter (1.90 Å) and two longer (1.91 Å) Mn-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Li and two equivalent Mn atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing OLi₄Mn₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Li and two equivalent Mn atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing OLi₄Mn₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-8°.

In the third Li site, Li is bonded to six O atoms to form LiO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one LiO₆ octahedra, corners with five equivalent CrO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent CrO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight LiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-11°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.22 Å. Cr is bonded to six O atoms to form CrO₆ octahedra that share corners with six LiO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent CrO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight LiO₆ octahedra. mp-850919.description: Li₂Cr₂MnO₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are two inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded to six O atoms to form LiO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MnO₆ octahedra, corners with five CrO₆ octahedra, edges with two MnO₆ octahedra, edges with three LiO₆ octahedra, and edges with four CrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-11°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.17-2.23 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded to six O atoms to form LiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent CrO₆ octahedra, corners with four MnO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra, edges with three LiO₆ octahedra, and edges with four CrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-10°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.16-2.24 Å. There are two inequivalent Cr sites. In the first Cr site, Cr is bonded to six O atoms to form CrO₆ octahedra that share corners with four LiO₆ octahedra, edges with two MnO₆ octahedra, edges with four LiO₆ octahedra, and edges with four CrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-11°. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.07 Å. In the second Cr site, Cr is bonded to six O atoms to form CrO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent LiO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra, edges with four LiO₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent CrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-10°. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.05 Å. There are two inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with four LiO₆ octahedra, edges with two MnO₆ octahedra, edges with four LiO₆ octahedra, and edges with four CrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-8°. There are four shorter (1.95 Å) and two longer (1.97 Å) Mn-O bond lengths. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent LiO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent LiO₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent CrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 10°. There are two shorter (1.91 Å) and four longer (1.99 Å) Mn-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Li, two Cr, and one Mn atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing OLi₂MnCr₂ square pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Li and three Cr atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing OLi₂Cr₃ square pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Li, two equivalent Cr, and one Mn atom to form OLi₂MnCr₂ square pyramids that share corners with nine OLi₂MnCr₂ square pyramids and edges with eight OLi₂Mn₂Cr square pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two Li, one Cr, and two Mn atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing OLi₂Mn₂Cr square pyramids. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Li, one Cr, and two equivalent Mn atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing OLi₂Mn₂Cr square pyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two Li and three Cr atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing OLi₂Cr₃ square pyramids.

mp-753906.description: Li₂MnO₂F is beta Polonium-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are three inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded to four equivalent O and two equivalent F atoms to form LiO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent LiO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with four equivalent MnO₄F₂ octahedra, edges with four equivalent MnO₄F₂ octahedra, and edges with eight LiO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-8°. All Li-O bond lengths are 2.21 Å. Both Li-F bond lengths are 2.01 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded to four equivalent O and two equivalent F atoms to form LiO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with six LiO₄F₂ octahedra, edges with six LiO₄F₂ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent MnO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-8°. All Li-O bond lengths are 2.20 Å. Both Li-F bond lengths are 2.04 Å. In the third Li site, Li is bonded to four equivalent O and two equivalent F atoms to form LiO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent LiO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with four equivalent MnO₄F₂ octahedra, edges with four equivalent MnO₄F₂ octahedra, and edges with eight LiO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-8°. There are two shorter (2.05 Å) and two longer (2.15 Å) Li-O bond lengths. Both Li-F bond lengths are 2.27 Å. Mn is bonded to four equivalent O and two equivalent F atoms to form MnO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with six LiO₄F₂ octahedra, edges with three equivalent MnO₄F₂ octahedra, and edges with nine LiO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-8°. There are two shorter (1.91 Å) and two longer (2.04 Å) Mn-O bond lengths. Both Mn-F bond lengths are 2.24 Å. O is bonded to four Li and two equivalent Mn atoms to form OLi₄Mn₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent FLi₄Mn₂ octahedra, corners with four equivalent OLi₄Mn₂ octahedra, edges with five equivalent FLi₄Mn₂ octahedra, and edges with seven equivalent OLi₄Mn₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-7°. F is bonded to four Li and two equivalent Mn atoms to form FLi₄Mn₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent FLi₄Mn₂ octahedra, corners with four equivalent OLi₄Mn₂ octahedra, edges with two equivalent FLi₄Mn₂ octahedra, and edges with ten equivalent OLi₄Mn₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-7°.
